about: Sense THRESHOLD (types/0x0030-sense.md §5.4, §5.5): profile env, ep4 TEMPERATURE, thresholds 18.00 / 26.00 °C, hysteresis 0.50 °C. Threshold (zone, value) goes out at every crossing between zones and only then: into ABOVE_HIGH above High, into BELOW_LOW below Low, back to NORMAL at High − hysteresis or Low + hysteresis; ABOVE_HIGH straight to BELOW_LOW is one event. The zone is set by the first good reading without an event — no crossing has happened (§5.5). A failed reading changes no zone. A threshold left absent is inactive. The event goes out before the report of the same measurement. Thresholds default to absent; the hysteresis the device exposes defaults to the quantity's report hysteresis (DEVICE-01).

steps.note: no cycle on ep4: only what the scenario is about goes out
the first reading is above High: the zone is set, no event
26.00 °C: at the threshold is not above it
the sensor fails: no event, the zone stays
back at 26.30 °C: still ABOVE_HIGH, no event
a reading below the old Low: back to NORMAL
and nothing below it any more
